# nomatron_destroy_job (Action)

Create a destroy plan for one live Nomad job managed by Nomatron. This stops and purges runtime state only; it does not delete the Nomatron job resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "nomatron_destroy_job" "web" {
  config {
    org_name = "acme"
    app_slug = "payments"
    job_slug = "web"

    # Set apply=true only when the destroy plan is ready for apply.
    # Approval-required plans must be approved in Nomatron before apply can be queued.
    apply = false
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_slug` (String) Application slug that owns the job.
- `job_slug` (String) Nomatron job slug whose live Nomad runtime should be stopped and purged.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name that owns the application.

### Optional

- `apply` (Boolean) When true, immediately queue a destroy apply if the destroy plan is ready for apply. Approval-required plans still need approval before apply can be queued.
